1. Can Merill's ability by applied to superior Rutor's Hand? Makes
sense that it should, but been getting conflicting reports from WotC
(so what else is new)?

2. When Delaying Action is used to cancel a vote, and the vote card
is returned to the hand, what happens to the card drawn to replace the
vote card?

Thanks,

--George

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
gf...@avalon.cs.ucdavis.edu (George Fink) writes:
>1. Can Merill's ability by applied to superior Rutor's Hand? Makes
>sense that it should, but been getting conflicting reports from WotC
>(so what else is new)?

Yes. Superior RH's damage si to be treated as if from a strike in combat,
and Merrill's ability can certainly be used at that time.

>2. When Delaying Action is used to cancel a vote, and the vote card
>is returned to the hand, what happens to the card drawn to replace the
>vote card?

Anytime you find yourself with more cards in hand than your hand capacity,
discard down to hand capacity. The card discarded (in this case) may be
the vote card just returned or any other card.
